Professional Summary
Results-oriented digital marketing and finance professional with cross-functional experience in performance marketing, CRM-driven campaigns, and financial operations. Strong background driving lead generation, optimizing paid channels, and managing accounting processes with compliance. Comfortable working in Agile environments and coordinating across product and operations teams. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Email Marketing, Tally, GST, Agile, Confluence

Work Experience

Digital Marketing Manager, Capgemini (Apr 2025 - Present)
- Led HubSpot-based nurture programs to convert enterprise prospects, increasing MQL-to-SQL conversion by 18% through targeted Email Marketing flows and segmentation.
- Managed cross-channel paid media campaigns using Google Ads and SEO recommendations to lower CPL by 22% while improving lead quality.
- Coordinated with product and sales teams in Agile sprints, documenting campaign requirements and retrospectives in Confluence.

Performance Marketer, Trellis Systems (Aug 2024 - Mar 2025)
- Optimized paid search and display campaigns on Google Ads, improving ROAS by 30% through creative A/B tests and bid strategy refinements.
- Instrumented end-to-end funnels with Google Analytics to identify drop-off points and informed HubSpot lead scoring rules that boosted lead engagement.
- Collaborated in sprint planning and maintained campaign playbooks and performance reports in Confluence.

Finance Executive, NimbusSoft (Oct 2022 - Jul 2024)
- Managed day-to-day accounting using Tally, handling ledger reconciliations, vendor payments, and month-end close activities.
- Prepared GST filings and ensured timely compliance, reducing discrepancies in tax returns through systematic reconciliations.
- Supported cross-functional teams with financial data for planning cycles and maintained financial process documentation in Confluence.

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
